text.description: The filters in the movement list section have incorrect behavior; if in the document filter I search for document 22, it should not also return another document that contains 22.

ops:
Given a filter on code 22
When I apply it
Then the grid shows exactly 5 rows
The grid shows exactly 5 rows after filtering by code 22, one per matching product, and the counter above the grid reads 5 results. Rows for code 220 are not shown.
